title: The Credential, its envelope and the identifiers
source: spec/socket-draft-00.md (doc rev 39), spec/ERRATA.md, spec/DECISIONS.md, registry/generated/registry.json, reference/python/bnap_ref.py
header: Credentials are TLV streams (draft-00 section 5). Context, Digest and ReplayKey follow
5.2 and 6.1, with attestations in the credential's sorted order. Scheme bodies are
placeholders, as in vectors.json. The witness key of the class S cases is
SHA-256("bnap test note key"): it signs the Digest, as the bnap:notes registry entry says.

Valid.description: A well-formed input every implementation must accept.

Size.description: Over the size limit; the HTTP cap is DECISIONS row 30.

UnknownOdd.description: An unknown odd record outside ext, which MUST NOT affect processing.

EmptyForms.description: The "or empty" forms of section 2: absent and empty hash the same.

Binding.description: The binding is in the Digest, not in the Context or the ReplayKey.

PathAttack.description: A path attacker changed the credential; the class S witness over the Digest no longer verifies.

SharedRail.description: One payment named by two schemes has one RailId.

TwoValue.description: More than one value credential in one request.

Ambiguous.description: draft-00 does not settle this; either answer is acceptable.
